required_facts_checked.claim: Unclear tasks make agents fill in missing decisions, even when the result looks convincing.
required_facts_checked.evidence: source: vague task and capable agent behavior

required_facts_checked.claim: Spec-driven development records users, problems, and expected behavior before code.
A chat assistant can clarify a vague idea and save the plan before backlog creation.
required_facts_checked.evidence: source: one question at a time and plan.md

required_facts_checked.claim: Backlog tasks should be session-sized and independent, with MVP scope reviewed.
required_facts_checked.evidence: source: task decomposition and scope review

required_facts_checked.claim: AGENTS.md and linked documents provide context engineering between sessions.
required_facts_checked.evidence: source: AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md, process and testing documents

required_facts_checked.claim: Loop engineering resumes work until a checkable condition is true.
required_facts_checked.evidence: source: groomed issues or passing tests as stop conditions

required_facts_checked.claim: A software engineer implements a groomed issue while QA verifies without fixing code.
required_facts_checked.evidence: source: engineer and QA role definitions

required_facts_checked.claim: Graph engineering assigns PM, engineer, and QA responsibilities through an orchestrator.
